lines: CECILIA D'SOUZA, role unknown, sells 230,000 shares in the offer for sale, so money is coming to them.
Proceeds of ₹16.10 crore are scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document's timetable.
Retained shares of ₹122.33 crore (estimate, valued at offer price) mean more value remains with them after listing.
Caveat: average cost of acquisition is unknown, so the gain figure cannot be shown.
